what: Addendum to preregistration.json, for R2c ONLY (gen5 5 s vs the human clone). Written 2026-10-01 AFTER R2a was read and while R2b was running, BEFORE R2c's first game. It changes nothing about R2a or R2b, and they are read by the original file.
why: R2a's read (r2a-gen5-vs-gen0r2-read.json) shows the search was starved for long stretches. X's decision mean was 1,567 ms on a 1,000 ms budget. Whole-machine CPU read 54-77% busy with only 3 BELOWNORMAL workers of this run, and node processes this agent did not start were consuming CPU. No R2a rule made it VOID, because none was written for this, so it is reported as read and labelled DEGRADED. R2c's preregistration gets the bar R2a lacked.
added_capability_bar_r2c: R2c is VOID (reported, not re-read) if the prior-fallback share (sprt_read.js search_counters_all_played.prior_fallback_share) is above 0.05. Also reported, not barred: playouts per searched decision, zero-playout decisions, X decision ms mean against the 5,000 ms budget.
